name: Brick Breaker
description: Smash glowing walls of bricks across six levels. Chain hits for combo multipliers, catch power-ups, and chase the high score.
controls: Mouse/touch or Arrows/A/D move the paddle; click/tap/Space launches the ball and fires lasers; M mute; F3 debug overlay.

achievements.name: Chain Reaction
achievements.description: Break 10 bricks in a single combo without touching the paddle.

achievements.name: Flawless
achievements.description: Clear a level without losing a life.
